parameters.subject: Order Workflow Failed, Check The Last Order
parameters.message:
=

The order workflow stopped on {{ $json.execution.lastNodeExecuted }}.

{{ $json.execution.error.message }}

The incoming order is kept in the execution log: open the failed run.

parameters.content:
## 1. Receive And Validate
Order form posts to the webhook. Text is trimmed, the date set to Swiss time, the total calculated. Missing fields, a bad email or a non-numeric quantity or price send the order to Errors.

## 2. Save And Notify
Order ID checked against the Orders tab first. A new order is saved with Status New, then the owner summary and the customer confirmation go out.

## 3. Nothing Gets Lost
Invalid orders, duplicates and any failed step land on the Errors tab with the full order data, and the owner gets an alert. Every external step retries 3 times first.
